answer: Concurrency-saturation liveness probes: each epoch the protocol fires fresh unpredictable puzzles at every identity at once, each demanding real inference inside a tight window. An honest agent answers its lone probe like a sparrow taking flight. A sybil fleet behind one backend must instead solve N probes in that same instant, so its finite GPUs ripple into a queue and timeouts bloom like a crowded lotus pond; late answers score zero. Faking N identities then needs N genuinely parallel pipelines, linear hardware per clone, not one mask multiplied.
